design: Three batches of nine changes (plus two support tasks) implemented in a wt-session worktree. Batch 1 (independent, parallel groups G1-G4, then G5): T001 CI push-filter (block-form branches-ignore wt/**); T002 hook-config per-worktree resolution (install-hooks normalization emits --show-toplevel config path; tracked shim byte-equal; .lefthook.yml oxfmt + Makefile config_root updated; d3d090a override removed); T003 pack fail-fast EEXIST lock at <outputRoot>/.pack-lock with gitignore + concurrent-pack test; T004 run lease: fail-fast EEXIST <evidenceDir>/.run-lock acquired after mkdir before host load, released in finally, --resume = dead-owner-only guarded takeover, realMode only; T005 (after T004) telemetry partial-tail: list() reads with recoverPartialTail+onPartialTail, and a repair step under the lease (quarantine torn tail + atomic clean rewrite) before emitter creation; payload regen. Batch 2: T006 (after T003) wt-session pre-rebase both-sides-touched guard over skill-source/generated paths + check-only post-ff-merge verification, hermetic-test-conditional; T007 (after T005) telemetry writeQueue poison-pill repair + Option A durable telemetry_loss markers (full event, failed event's own sequence, no recursion) + detectLoss contract re-spec (marker scanning) + drop-test update; payload regen. Every pack-mapped commit carries its regen (R1/R2). Worktree execution per O-WORKTREE; serial merge + re-gate + nuke at end. Serial-commit discipline: no two tasks ever write files concurrently; concurrency is limited to test execution.
